title: Aloo Paratha
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes with onion, chili and cumin to make filling
Knead dough with flour and water, divide into balls
Stuff dough with potato filling and roll out gently
Cook on tawa with ghee until golden brown on both sides

title: Anda Paratha
instructions: Roll out plain paratha and half-cook on tawa
Beat egg with chopped onion, chili and salt
Pour egg mixture on paratha and fold, cook until egg sets
Flip and cook both sides until golden

title: Cheese Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper
Heat butter in pan and pour egg mixture
Sprinkle cheese once eggs start to set
Fold omelette in half and serve hot

title: Halwa Puri
instructions: Knead stiff dough with flour and water, rest for 20 minutes
Roll small circles and deep fry puris until puffed and golden
Roast semolina in ghee until golden, add sugar water and cardamom
Cook halwa until thick, serve with hot puris and chana

title: Sheermal
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm milk, rest 10 minutes
Knead dough with flour, ghee and yeast mixture, prove 1 hour
Shape into flat rounds and brush with saffron milk
Bake in oven until golden brown on top

title: Suji Halwa
instructions: Roast semolina in ghee until light golden and fragrant
Boil water with sugar to make syrup
Slowly add hot syrup to roasted semolina, stirring constantly
Cook until thick, garnish with almonds and cardamom

title: Chana Chaat
instructions: Mix boiled chickpeas with chopped onion and tomato
Add tamarind chutney and chaat masala
Toss well and garnish with fresh coriander
Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: Dahi Baray
instructions: Soak and grind lentils into thick batter, whip until fluffy
Deep fry small balls until golden, soak in water then squeeze
Whisk yogurt with salt and layer over baray
Top with tamarind chutney and spices before serving

title: French Toast
instructions: Whisk egg, milk, sugar and cinnamon together
Dip bread slices in egg mixture until coated
Fry on buttered pan until golden on both sides
Serve warm with honey or syrup

title: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Chop vegetables finely
Whisk eggs with salt and mix in vegetables
Pour onto hot oiled pan and cook until set
Fold and serve hot

title: Paratha Roll
instructions: Half fry paratha, crack egg on top and spread evenly
Cook until egg sets then flip briefly
Place cooked chicken boti, onion and chutney in center
Roll tightly and slice in half to serve

title: Lassi Bowl with Fruits
instructions: Blend yogurt, milk and sugar until smooth
Pour into a bowl
Top with sliced banana and berries
Serve chilled immediately

title: Nihari
instructions: Fry sliced onion until golden and set aside for garnish
Cook beef with ginger garlic paste and nihari masala until browned
Add water and simmer on low heat for 3-4 hours until tender
Add flour slurry to thicken gravy, garnish with fried onion and ginger

title: Karak Chai Toast
instructions: Toast buttered bread slices until crisp
Boil milk with tea leaves, sugar and cardamom
Strain tea into cup
Serve hot karak chai alongside toast

title: Besan Cheela
instructions: Mix gram flour with water to form smooth batter
Add chopped onion, chili, coriander and salt
Pour thin layer on hot greased pan
Cook both sides until golden and crisp

title: Chicken Karahi
instructions: Heat oil and fry chicken with ginger garlic paste until sealed
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until oil separates
Add karahi masala and green chilies, cook covered until chicken is tender
Garnish with ginger julienne and coriander

title: Mutton Karahi
instructions: Fry mutton in oil with ginger garlic paste until browned
Add yogurt and cook on medium heat until absorbed
Add tomatoes and cook until soft and oil separates
Add masala, cover and simmer until mutton is tender

title: Chicken Qorma
instructions: Fry sliced onions until golden brown and blend into paste
Fry chicken with ginger garlic paste until sealed
Add yogurt, onion paste and qorma masala, cook until oil separates
Add water, simmer covered until chicken is tender and gravy thickens

title: Beef Qorma
instructions: Fry sliced onions golden and blend into paste
Brown beef pieces with ginger garlic paste
Add yogurt, onion paste and masala, cook until oil separates
Add water and simmer until beef is tender, about 1 hour

title: Aloo Gosht
instructions: Fry onions until golden, add ginger garlic paste and mutton
Cook mutton until browned, add tomatoes and spices
Add water and pressure cook or simmer until meat is tender
Add potatoes and cook until soft

title: Palak Gosht
instructions: Fry onions and ginger garlic paste, add mutton and brown well
Blanch and puree spinach
Add spinach puree to mutton along with green chilies
Simmer until mutton is tender and gravy thickens

title: Bhindi Gosht
instructions: Fry okra separately until slightly crisp, set aside
Cook mutton with onion, ginger garlic paste and tomato until tender
Add fried okra to the mutton curry
Simmer briefly to combine flavors and serve

title: Chicken Handi
instructions: Fry chicken with ginger garlic paste until sealed
Add tomato paste and handi masala, cook until oil separates
Add cream and simmer until gravy thickens
Garnish with julienned ginger and green chili

title: Chicken Jalfrezi
instructions: Stir fry chicken strips in oil until cooked through
Add sliced onion and capsicum, stir fry briefly
Add tomatoes and soy sauce, cook on high heat
Toss until sauce coats chicken and vegetables stay crisp

title: Kadhai Chicken
instructions: Fry chicken with ginger garlic paste until sealed
Add tomatoes and kadhai masala, cook until oil separates
Add capsicum and cook until chicken is tender
Garnish with coriander and serve hot

title: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate and grill chicken pieces until cooked
Cook tomato puree with butter and ginger garlic paste until thick
Add cream and kasuri methi, simmer to combine
Add grilled chicken and simmer until coated in sauce

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Fry onions until golden brown
Add ginger garlic paste and chicken, cook until sealed
Add tomatoes and masala, cook until oil separates
Add water and simmer until chicken is tender

title: Mutton Curry
instructions: Fry onions until golden, add ginger garlic paste and mutton
Brown mutton pieces well on medium-high heat
Add tomatoes and masala, cook until oil separates
Add water, cover and simmer until mutton is tender

title: Beef Nihari
instructions: Fry onion until golden, add ginger garlic paste and beef
Cook beef with nihari masala until browned
Add water and simmer on very low heat for 3-4 hours
Thicken with flour slurry and garnish with ginger julienne

title: Haleem
instructions: Soak wheat and lentils overnight, then boil until very soft
Cook chicken separately with masala until tender, then shred
Blend wheat and lentils to a coarse paste, combine with shredded chicken
Simmer together for 1-2 hours, stirring frequently, finish with ghee garnish

title: Daal Chawal (Masoor)
instructions: Boil lentils with turmeric and salt until soft
Prepare tadka with fried onion, garlic and cumin seeds
Pour tadka over cooked daal and simmer briefly
Serve hot with steamed rice

title: Daal Makhani
instructions: Soak and boil lentils and beans until very soft
Cook tomato puree with butter and ginger garlic paste
Add boiled lentils and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes
Finish with cream and a knob of butter before serving

title: Chana Masala
instructions: Fry onions until golden, add ginger garlic paste
Add tomatoes and masala, cook until oil separates
Add boiled chickpeas and a little water
Simmer until gravy thickens and flavors combine

title: Rajma
instructions: Soak and boil kidney beans until soft
Prepare masala base with fried onion, tomato and ginger garlic paste
Add boiled beans and simmer with a little bean water
Cook until gravy thickens, mash a few beans for texture

title: Aloo Palak
instructions: Boil and blanch spinach, then puree
Fry onion and garlic with cumin seeds
Add diced potatoes and cook until half done
Add spinach puree and simmer until potatoes are fully cooked

title: Bhindi Fry
instructions: Wash and dry okra thoroughly, slice lengthwise
Fry okra in oil until edges are crisp
Add onion and tomato, cook until softened
Season with spices and cook uncovered until dry

title: Baingan Bharta
instructions: Roast whole eggplant over flame until skin is charred and flesh soft
Peel and mash the roasted eggplant
Fry onion, garlic, tomato and chili until soft
Add mashed eggplant and cook until well combined

title: Karela Gosht
instructions: Salt bitter gourd and rest 20 minutes, then rinse and fry until crisp
Cook mutton with onion, ginger garlic paste and yogurt until tender
Add fried bitter gourd to the mutton curry
Simmer briefly to blend flavors before serving

title: Mix Vegetable Curry
instructions: Fry onion until golden, add ginger garlic paste
Add tomatoes and curry powder, cook until oil separates
Add mixed vegetables and a little water
Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender

title: Shami Kabab Curry
instructions: Prepare gravy by frying onion, tomato and ginger garlic paste
Add yogurt and cook until oil separates
Gently place shami kababs into the gravy
Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes without breaking kababs

title: Kofta Curry
instructions: Shape minced meat into balls (koftas)
Prepare gravy with fried onion, tomato, yogurt and spices
Gently drop koftas into simmering gravy
Cook covered on low heat until koftas are cooked through

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka masala, then grill or bake
Cook tomato puree with oil until thickened
Add cream and simmer to make sauce
Add grilled chicken tikka pieces and simmer briefly

title: Fish Curry
instructions: Marinate fish lightly with turmeric and salt
Prepare gravy with fried onion, tomato and masala
Add water and bring to a simmer
Gently add fish pieces and cook until just done

title: Prawn Masala
instructions: Clean and devein prawns
Prepare masala base with fried onion and tomato
Add prawns and cook on medium heat
Cook until prawns turn pink, do not overcook

title: Achari Chicken
instructions: Heat mustard oil until smoking, then cool slightly
Fry onion and add chicken with achar masala and fennel seeds
Add tomatoes and cook until oil separates
Simmer covered until chicken is tender and tangy

title: Chicken Do Pyaza
instructions: Fry half the onions until golden and set aside
Cook chicken with remaining onion, tomato and masala
Add fried onion back in towards the end of cooking
Simmer until chicken is tender and gravy thickens

title: Mutton Rara
instructions: Cook mutton pieces with onion and spices until tender
Separately fry minced mutton until browned and crumbly
Combine both mutton preparations in one pan
Simmer together for 10 minutes to blend flavors

title: Chapli Kabab
instructions: Mix minced beef with chopped tomato, onion, spices and egg
Shape mixture into flat round patties
Shallow fry in hot oil until browned on both sides
Drain excess oil and serve hot

title: Seekh Kabab
instructions: Mix minced meat with grated onion, ginger garlic paste and spices
Knead mixture well and shape onto skewers
Grill or pan fry until cooked through and charred
Serve hot with mint chutney and naan

title: Grilled Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, garlic and herbs for 1 hour
Preheat grill or pan on medium-high heat
Grill chicken pieces, basting occasionally with oil
Cook until internal temperature is safe and juices run clear

title: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Cook chicken with yogurt, biryani masala and fried onion until tender
Parboil rice separately with whole spices until 70% done
Layer rice over chicken gravy in a pot
Cover and cook on low heat (dum) for 20 minutes before mixing gently

title: Mutton Biryani
instructions: Cook mutton with yogurt and biryani masala until tender
Parboil rice with whole spices until partially done
Layer rice over mutton gravy and fried onion
Seal and cook on dum for 25-30 minutes before serving

title: Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Fry onion and whole spices in oil until fragrant
Add vegetables and ginger garlic paste, sauté briefly
Add soaked rice and water, bring to a boil
Cover and cook on low heat until rice is fluffy

title: Chicken Pulao
instructions: Fry onion until golden, add chicken and ginger garlic paste
Cook chicken until sealed, add whole spices and water to make yakhni
Strain stock, add soaked rice to the stock and bring to boil
Cover and cook on low heat until rice is done, then fold in chicken

title: Yakhni Pulao
instructions: Boil mutton with whole spices to make a fragrant stock (yakhni)
Strain stock and reserve meat separately
Fry onion, add yogurt and meat, then add strained stock and rice
Cook covered on low heat until rice is fluffy and fully cooked

title: Beef Biryani
instructions: Cook beef with yogurt and biryani masala until tender
Parboil rice with whole spices
Layer rice over beef gravy with fried onion and herbs
Cook on dum for 25 minutes before mixing gently and serving

title: Kabuli Pulao
instructions: Cook mutton with onion and whole spices until tender, reserve stock
Julienne and lightly fry carrots with raisins until caramelized
Cook rice in the reserved mutton stock until fluffy
Layer rice with mutton and top with caramelized carrots and raisins

title: Matar Pulao
instructions: Fry onion and whole spices until fragrant
Add peas and ginger garlic paste, sauté briefly
Add soaked rice and appropriate water, bring to boil
Cover and simmer on low heat until rice is fully cooked

title: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble eggs in hot oil and set aside
Sauté garlic and spring onion briefly
Add cooked rice and soy sauce, stir fry on high heat
Fold in scrambled eggs and toss to combine

title: Zarda (Sweet Rice)
instructions: Parboil rice with cardamom until nearly cooked, drain
Melt ghee and add sugar with a little water to make syrup
Add rice and food color to the syrup, cook on low heat covered
Garnish with almonds before serving

title: Samosa
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes, mix with peas and spices
Fill samosa patti with potato mixture and fold into triangles
Seal edges with flour paste
Deep fry until golden and crisp

title: Pakora
instructions: Slice onion and potato thinly
Mix with gram flour, spices and a little water to form thick batter
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil
Fry until golden and crisp, drain excess oil

title: Spring Rolls
instructions: Julienne vegetables and stir fry with soy sauce until slightly soft
Cool filling before wrapping
Fill wrappers and roll tightly, sealing edges with water
Deep fry until golden and crisp

title: Chicken Roll
instructions: Cook chicken boti with spices until done
Warm paratha lightly on tawa
Layer chutney, chicken, onion and lettuce on paratha
Roll tightly and slice to serve

title: Vegetable Cutlet
instructions: Mash potatoes and mix with finely chopped boiled vegetables
Season and shape mixture into flat patties
Coat patties in corn flour slurry and bread crumbs
Shallow fry until golden and crisp on both sides

title: Aloo Tikki
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes until smooth
Mix in corn flour, chopped chili, coriander and chaat masala
Shape into small round patties
Shallow fry until golden and crisp on both sides

title: Dahi Phulki
instructions: Whip gram flour batter with baking soda until fluffy
Deep fry small drops of batter until golden
Soak fried phulki in water briefly, then squeeze out
Layer with whisked yogurt and tamarind chutney before serving

title: Papri Chaat
instructions: Arrange papri on a serving plate
Top with boiled chickpeas and diced boiled potato
Drizzle with whisked yogurt and tamarind chutney
Sprinkle chaat masala and serve immediately

title: Fruit Chaat
instructions: Chop all fruits into bite-sized pieces
Combine in a large bowl
Sprinkle chaat masala and lemon juice
Toss gently and serve chilled

title: Sandwich Club
instructions: Toast bread slices lightly
Spread mayonnaise on each slice
Layer chicken, cheese, lettuce and tomato between slices
Cut diagonally and secure with toothpicks

title: Chicken Nuggets Homemade
instructions: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces
Coat pieces in flour, then beaten egg, then bread crumbs
Rest coated pieces in fridge for 15 minutes
Deep fry until golden and cooked through

title: French Fries
instructions: Cut potatoes into even strips and soak in water for 20 minutes
Dry thoroughly and fry once at medium heat until soft
Fry a second time at high heat until golden and crisp
Drain and season with salt immediately

title: Bread Pakora
instructions: Prepare thick gram flour batter with spices and water
Cut bread slices diagonally into triangles
Dip bread in batter, coating fully
Deep fry until golden brown and crisp

title: Chicken Corn Soup
instructions: Bring chicken stock to a boil and add corn and shredded chicken
Mix corn flour with water and add to thicken soup
Drizzle beaten egg slowly while stirring to form ribbons
Season with soy sauce and simmer briefly before serving

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Sauté garlic in butter until fragrant
Add chopped vegetables and stock, bring to a boil
Simmer until vegetables are tender
Thicken slightly with corn flour slurry and season with pepper

title: Kheer
instructions: Soak rice for 20 minutes then boil in milk until soft
Simmer on low heat, stirring often, until mixture thickens
Add sugar and cardamom powder, cook a few more minutes
Garnish with almonds and pistachios, serve warm or chilled

title: Gulab Jamun
instructions: Make sugar syrup by boiling sugar and water together, keep warm
Knead milk powder, flour and milk into a soft dough
Shape into smooth balls, ensuring no cracks
Deep fry on low heat until deep golden, then soak in warm syrup

title: Gajar Halwa
instructions: Grate carrots finely
Cook grated carrots in milk until milk reduces and carrots soften
Add sugar and ghee, cook until mixture thickens
Fold in khoya and garnish with almonds before serving

title: Sheer Khurma
instructions: Roast vermicelli in ghee until light golden
Boil milk and add roasted vermicelli
Add chopped dates, nuts and sugar, simmer until thickened
Serve warm garnished with extra nuts

title: Ras Malai
instructions: Curdle milk with lemon juice to make paneer, drain and knead smooth
Shape paneer into small flat discs
Boil discs in sugar syrup until they double in size
Soak cooked discs in reduced sweetened milk flavored with cardamom and saffron

title: Kulfi
instructions: Boil milk until reduced to half, stirring frequently
Add condensed milk and cardamom powder, mix well
Pour into kulfi molds and add chopped nuts
Freeze for at least 6 hours until set

title: Custard
instructions: Mix custard powder with a little cold milk to form paste
Boil remaining milk with sugar
Add custard paste to boiling milk, stirring continuously until thick
Cool slightly and fold in chopped fruits before chilling

title: Fruit Trifle
instructions: Layer sponge cake pieces at the bottom of a glass dish
Add a layer of jelly followed by custard
Add chopped fruits and repeat layers
Top with whipped cream and chill before serving

title: Jalebi
instructions: Mix flour, yogurt and water into a smooth fermented-style batter, rest 8 hours
Prepare sugar syrup with water and food color, keep warm
Pipe batter into hot oil in spiral shapes and fry until crisp
Soak fried jalebi in warm syrup for a minute before serving

title: Barfi
instructions: Heat ghee and add milk powder, mixing continuously
Add condensed milk and cardamom, cook until mixture thickens into dough
Spread mixture onto a greased tray and smooth the top
Garnish with pistachios, cool and cut into squares

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Boil rice in milk on low heat until soft and creamy
Add sugar and cinnamon, cook until desired thickness
Stir in raisins
Serve warm or chilled with a cinnamon dusting

title: Shahi Tukda
instructions: Fry bread slices in ghee until golden and crisp, cut diagonally
Reduce milk with sugar and saffron until thickened (rabri)
Arrange fried bread in a dish and pour rabri over it
Garnish with almonds and chill before serving

title: Malpora
instructions: Make a smooth batter with flour, milk, sugar and fennel seeds
Rest batter for 20 minutes
Pour small rounds of batter into hot oil and fry until golden
Soak fried malpora in sugar syrup briefly before serving

title: Sooji Cake
instructions: Mix semolina, yogurt, sugar and oil into a smooth batter, rest 15 minutes
Add baking powder and mix gently
Pour batter into greased cake tin
Bake at 180C for 25-30 minutes until a skewer comes out clean

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Melt chocolate gently over a double boiler, cool slightly
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale, fold into melted chocolate
Fold in whipped cream gently to keep mixture airy
Divide into serving cups and chill for at least 2 hours

title: Doodh Patti Chai
instructions: Boil milk and water together
Add tea leaves and boil until color develops
Add sugar and simmer briefly
Strain into cups and serve hot

title: Green Tea
instructions: Boil water and let it cool slightly
Steep green tea bag for 2-3 minutes
Remove tea bag and add honey and lemon
Stir and serve warm

title: Mango Lassi
instructions: Combine mango pulp, yogurt, milk and sugar in blender
Blend until smooth and frothy
Adjust consistency with more milk if needed
Pour into glasses and serve chilled

title: Rooh Afza Sharbat
instructions: Pour rooh afza syrup into a glass
Add chilled water and stir well
Add ice cubes
Serve immediately

title: Lemon Mint Cooler
instructions: Muddle mint leaves gently with sugar
Add lemon juice and water, stir until sugar dissolves
Strain if desired and add ice cubes
Garnish with a mint sprig and serve

title: Fresh Orange Juice
instructions: Juice the oranges using a juicer or by hand
Strain juice to remove excess pulp if preferred
Add sugar and stir to dissolve
Pour over ice and serve immediately

title: Sugarcane Juice
instructions: Extract juice from sugarcane using a juicer along with ginger
Strain juice into a glass
Add lemon juice and stir
Serve over ice immediately for best taste

title: Falooda
instructions: Layer soaked basil seeds and falooda sev at the bottom of a glass
Add rooh afza syrup
Pour chilled milk over the layers
Top with a scoop of ice cream and serve immediately

title: Cold Coffee
instructions: Combine milk, coffee and sugar in a blender
Blend until frothy and well combined
Add ice cubes and blend briefly again
Pour into glasses and serve immediately

title: Badam Milk
instructions: Peel and grind soaked almonds into a fine paste
Boil milk with sugar and almond paste
Add cardamom powder and saffron, simmer for 5 minutes
Serve warm or chilled
